vendor source of truth. Every route below was taken from the @add_route declarations at commit ea7d780e1bcaa9a2f970e7e615b6c11bf11af6d6 (setup.py version 2.7.0, master, 2026-07-31), and every response envelope from the handler that builds it.

notes: SENAITE LIMS is an open-source laboratory information management system built on Plone; its REST surface is the senaite.jsonapi add-on, mounted at the Plone site's @@API traversal point with the base route /senaite/v1. There is no vendor machine spec, so this document was authored from the add-on's own route declarations (@add_route in src/senaite/jsonapi/v1/routes/*.py at commit ea7d780e, setup.py version 2.7.0) cross-checked against the Sphinx docs. Coverage is 'full': all 35 operations of the API are here — version, auth/login/logout (plus their /users aliases), users, catalogs, registry, settings, search, push and the generic content routes — and that is the complete route table, not a slice. Completeness is 'best-effort' (docs-only) because the JSON API is schemaless by design: a content record is whatever catalog metadata or schema fields the portal type carries, so ContentRecord declares the keys every record has and stays open, and Client/Contact/AnalysisRequest add the commonly-used fields of those portal types without claiming to be exhaustive. Two modelling notes. First, the routing is Werkzeug-based and distinguishes a UID segment by its 32-character length, which OpenAPI path templates cannot express: /{resource} therefore also matches a bare UID (and then returns the single record rather than the batch envelope), and the create/update/delete verb routes are written out as literal paths. Second, the JWT half of /login (Bearer tokens, the 'token' cookie) and the permission checks on /registry and /settings arrived in senaite.jsonapi 2.7.0 and need its GenericSetup profile installed; 2.6.x instances answer /login with the __ac session cookie only, which is what the OpenFn adaptor reuses. The adaptor itself exposes only request(method, path, options) against this base, so any of these routes is reachable from a job.
